Subject: Great demo today — next steps / POC scope

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — really helpful to see Redwood's latency guarantees and the routing/fallback features. A few quick notes from our side and an ask for a proposed POC plan: 

Recap / what we care about:
- Throughput: must support ~50 concurrent requests during batch runs (peak).
- Latency: 95th <= 250ms for single-shot prompts under realistic load.
- Cost: target is to stay within $X/token budget (we'll share expected QPS).
- Data handling: logs/audit must be available for 30 days and customer-managed KMS for keys.

POC ask:
Could you send a one-page POC outline that includes: success criteria (how we'd judge pass/fail), evaluation plan (tests and sample prompts), timeline, owners on both sides, and any prep we need to do? We'd like to run the POC with a small dataset and a portion of our search-ranking flow. Procurement may need a SOW for any committed work — looping them in on next replies.

We're aiming to start the POC the week of Jul 20 if possible. Let me know if that timeline works and any blockers.

Best,
Laura

Hi Laura — really appreciate the clear success criteria. Attached is a concise POC outline we discussed (redwood-poc-outline.pdf) and a SOW template (sow-template.docx) for procurement. Below is the high-level plan; please confirm or flag changes and we can lock dates.

Proposed POC: Demo recap + 3-week evaluation (target start: week of Jul 20)

Success criteria (pass if >= 4/5 met):
- Latency: 95th percentile <= 250ms for live queries under test load (we will run a realistic replay).
- Throughput: sustain 50 concurrent requests with <= 5% error rate during batch window.
- Output quality: automated eval on 500 sample prompts shows >= baseline F1 / relevance lift of X% vs current model.
- Stability: no more than 2 incidents requiring restart; KV cache hit rate >= target (we'll define).
- Security/compliance: audit logs available and KMS integrated for test keys.

Evaluation plan / tests:
- Week 0 (prep): data sampling, access & network tests, keys exchanged, confirm HubSpot/dev env access.
- Week 1 (baseline + integration): run baseline model, validate latency/throughput under small load, smoke tests.
- Week 2 (stress + quality): scale to target QPS, run automated quality evals, collect logs & traces.
- Week 3 (wrap & review): joint review, run final pass, produce results doc and recommendations.

Timeline & owners:
- Redwood: Dylan Brooks (SE) — integration, load harness, observability setup; Evelyn Hart (CS) — program manager, reporting; Marissa Cole — commercial owner and escalation.
- FinBank: Laura Chen — product owner; FinBank infra (procurement) — SOW signoff; engineering lead (TBD) — integration.

Deliverables:
- POC runbook and test harness repo link
- Weekly status notes and final results doc
- Optional: configuration recommendations and a small cost estimate for production scaling

Next steps:
1) If you confirm the success criteria and timeline, we'll schedule a prep call (30-45m) with Dylan/Evelyn to go over data access and runbook (suggest Jul 13 or Jul 15).
2) I'll provide the SOW template for procurement to edit.
3) Dylan will share the integration checklist and preflight tests.

If that looks good I can also loop in Rishi (sales lead) for commercial bits this week.

Thanks — attaching the one-pager now.

Best,
Marissa Cole
